basic_info.main_problem: I feel the yoga class being canceled ruined my state for the whole week, leading to strong disappointment and frustration.
basic_info.core_demands: 我的情绪反应可能与情境not成比例，这促使我寻求咨询。

core_beliefs: Needs to keep strict control to maintain stability and relaxation

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my self-care (yoga) is disrupted, my whole week will be ruined
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to distract with other activities, but with limited effect

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Things must develop as I envision; otherwise it will be terrible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to avoid change, sticks to the original plan
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这not该发生；我受not了这样的变化

special_situations.event: When considering replacing yoga with meditation or walking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not是瑜伽，效果就not会一样好，可能再次让我失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowers expectations before trying; hesitates about taking action
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 它们可能not如瑜伽有效；我not想再次失望

special_situations.event: When reviewing this week's schedule and feelings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次计划受挫就等于整周失败，其他积极部分not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly focuses on the negative, ignoring alternatives and positive factors

core_conflict.wish: Longs for stable, controllable self-care and order to gain safety and relaxation
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失去掌控后Emotional loss of control、整周陷入混乱与低落
defense_goal: 维持对计划的严格掌控以降低Anxiety
避免not可Anticipation的变化以保持情绪稳定

object_relations.self_representation: A self who needs control and is easily disrupted by change
object_relations.object_representation: 外界与变化是not可预测的干扰者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to try alternative self-care activities (such as meditation, walking)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识担心新活动without法达到与瑜伽同等的效果，会再次失望
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和，承认其担忧；引导分步尝试与设定现实Anticipation；use具体化Questioning，提供选择而非强行说服。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当意识到自己的反应可能与事件not相称并尝试以理性视角审视时（如“从宏观来看这只是瑜伽课”）
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 通过理性分析与抽象化来与情绪保持距离，以减少not适
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Affirms their self-awareness; gently invites them back to the body and present feelings; labels and concretizes emotions, avoiding excessive theorizing.

manifestations: 对计划变更高度not耐受、强烈需要掌控
Treating one cancellation as the whole week being ruined
Self-care highly dependent on a single activity (yoga)

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: An implicit sense of the rule 'things should go according to plan'
Finds change hard to tolerate, tends to stick to set arrangements

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Distracts with other activities when emotions are intense, but with limited effect
Avoiding direct contact with feelings of disappointment and frustration

exception_events.reason: 线索：not同情境与结构化的工作任务帮助维持稳定；同时具备一定的自我觉察，能识do not反应可能not成比例。
